segments.name: Communications technology
segments.description: Sells affordable Foxx-branded tablets, smartphones, wearables and IoT products to U.S. distributors, carriers and e-commerce customers, plus an App Service.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company has one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and e-commerce customers pay for Foxx-branded hardware, and App developer partners pay commission for installing applications on mobile devices.
revenueModel.evidence: We also provide an App Service by installing applications from App developer partners onto its mobile devices and facilitating the distribution of these devices to end users.

changes.text: In 2024, the company became public through a business combination with Acri Capital Acquisition Corporation and was renamed Foxx Development Holdings Inc.
changes.evidence: On September 26, 2024 (the "Closing"), Acri Capital Acquisition Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("ACAC") consummated a business combination pursuant to the terms of the business combination agreement
